name: Sworn to Protect
body:
Through a unique ritual, you may swear yourself to protect an individual with your life.

Benefit(s): By performing a 1 hour ritual, you may bind yourself with one other individual with an oath to protect them from harm. This individual is known as your Charge, and you may only have 1 Charge at a time. You may change your Charge to another creature, or remove any Charge you may have by performing this 1 hour ritual again.

You always know the state of your Charge if you are within 30 feet of them, as per the status spell. If you are further than 30 feet from your Charge, you know their relative location to you, as well as a general distance (close, medium, long, or far). If they are on another plane other than yours, you know what plane they are on.

If you are adjacent to your Charge, you may, as an immediate action, redirect any single target spell or effect, or an attack made against them to yourself.

Akashic Classes: Kheshig © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Anthony Cappel.
